analysis.description: This paper presents a novel methodology for generating vehicle-type specific sequences of waypoints by utilizing reinforcement learning artifacts from vehicle specific controllers. The approach involves training a generic behavioral model on data without vehicle parameters and then specializing it for specific vehicle types to improve the plausibility of generated waypoint sequences.

type.justification: The paper discusses the development of a theoretical framework and methodology for improving waypoint generation rather than focusing on empirical experiments or studies.
type.quote: Our novel methodology conditionally specializes such a behavior predictive model to a vehicle-type by utilizing byproducts of the reinforcement learning algorithms used to produce vehicle specific controllers.
